town_sign.text: Where every career starts with a password reset.

player_house_sign.text: Your house. The Wi-Fi password is on the fridge.

help_desk_sign.text: HELP DESK - Daemons restored free of charge.
Please describe your issue in detail. Tickets that say "it's broken" will be closed.

townsperson.speaker: Townsperson
townsperson.text: Wild Daemons hide in tangled cables. Nobody ever labels them.

townsperson.speaker: Townsperson
townsperson.text: Some say the cable tangles were here before the town. Some say the IT department just gave up.

kid.speaker: Kid
kid.text: My Dustbunny does a little dance when it's happy! Watch!

kid.speaker: Kid
kid.text: ...That was me. The Dustbunny is shy.

then.speaker: Mom
then.text: A Daemon of your own! Does it need a charger? A blanket? A firewall?

else.speaker: Mom
else.text: Go on, the Help Desk is the blue roof. Don't be late on day one!

else.speaker: Mom
else.text: First day at the Help Desk! I'm so proud of you, {player}.

else.speaker: Mom
else.text: Take these. Nobody fixes a printer on an empty stomach.

home_pc.text: It's your PC. 214 unread emails. All from Kevin.

kevins_mom.speaker: Kevin's Mom
kevins_mom.text: Kevin replied-all to the whole town again. I've changed the router password.

kevin_servers.text: Kevin's home lab. It's mostly blinking lights and one very warm Fanbat.

help_desk_tech.speaker: Help Desk
help_desk_tech.choice: Want me to restore your Daemons?

yes.speaker: Help Desk
yes.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

yes.speaker: Help Desk
yes.text: ...There. All fixed. Please rate your experience 1 to 5.

then.speaker: Intern
then.text: How's the Dustbunny? Don't let it near the keyboards.

else.speaker: Intern
else.text: I found this Dustbunny living behind Server 3.

yes.speaker: Intern
yes.text: Take good care of it. It sneezes on everything.

no.speaker: Intern
no.text: That's okay. It's kind of growing on me.

server_rack.text: You logged in to the Server Rack.
You logged out. Remember to lock your screen.

supply_closet.speaker: Supply Closet
supply_closet.text: Welcome to the Supply Closet! We stock everything except working printers.

intro_wake.text: BZZZT. BZZZT. Your alarm goes off. 7:59 AM.
Today is your first day on the Help Desk at Root Valley IT.
Your badge photo looks terrible. Your name is printed below it...

intro_wake.speaker: Mom
intro_wake.text: {player}! Your manager is waiting at the Help Desk. It's the building with the blue roof, south of the big road.

kevin_town_pre.speaker: Kevin
kevin_town_pre.text: Oh hey, new hire! The manager's handing out Daemons at the Help Desk today.

kevin_town_pre.speaker: Kevin
kevin_town_pre.text: I'm getting the best one. I already sent a calendar invite about it.

town_exit_block.speaker: Kevin
town_exit_block.text: Hey! Don't go into the cable tangles without a Daemon!

town_exit_block.speaker: Kevin
town_exit_block.text: Wild ones bite. The manager's handing them out at the Help Desk. Blue roof!

manager_starter.speaker: Manager
manager_starter.text: There you are, {player}! Welcome to the Help Desk.

manager_starter.speaker: Manager
manager_starter.text: Every new hire gets a Daemon to help with tickets. We keep them in the e-waste bin. Don't ask.

manager_starter.speaker: Manager
manager_starter.text: Pick one. They all still have their warranty stickers.

manager_starter.speaker: Manager
manager_starter.text: Good choice. Treat it well and it'll outlast every laptop in this building.

manager_starter.speaker: Kevin
manager_starter.text: WAIT! I'm a new hire too! I replied-all to the onboarding email!

then.speaker: Kevin
then.text: I'll take Pingo! Network beats Hardware. It's in the manual. I read the manual.

then.speaker: Kevin
then.text: I'll take Glowbit! Software reroutes Network. Checkmate.

else.speaker: Kevin
else.text: I'll take Chipmunk! You can't patch bad RAM. Ha!

then.speaker: Manager
then.text: A Desktop Support Cert already? You'll have my job by Friday. Please don't.

else.speaker: Manager
else.text: Your first assignment: head north through Route 1 and the Wi-Fi Dead Zone to Patch Town.

else.speaker: Manager
else.text: The Desktop Support department there runs certification trials. Earn your first cert.

then.speaker: Manager
then.text: Use Thumb Drives on weakened wild Daemons. Quarantine them, don't fight them all.

else.speaker: Manager
else.text: Take these. Company property, so try not to lose them.

route_1_north_sign.text: NORTH: Wi-Fi Dead Zone, then Patch Town.
Bring a map. Your phone won't help.
